test_graph_equality: test two gtn graphs for equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn graphs for isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic to check structural equivalence
load_graph_from_text: load a gtn graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt with node and arc definitions
save_graph_to_text: save a gtn graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt with start and accept node info
save_load_graph_binary: save and load a gtn graph to/from a binary file using gtn.save and gtn.load
